title: Prepare the first DE-Rebuild release
changes: Published FFTA DE-Rebuild v1.0.0 from main commit 8d276a0 on GitHub, with Linux and Windows portable packages, an Android preview APK and a SHA-256 checksum file.
validation: Linux Docker export reused a matching cached build and test stage; verified 82 manifest hashes and sizes, executable modes, branding and private-data exclusions. SHA256 ff20137489f37f3d1e341954931fa62699557797587b6b636d8c4764c04afec4.

Windows Docker cross-build and Wine suite passed 778 tests (356 ignored) after configuring UTF-8 and the external host symlink fixture; verified ZIP integrity, 82 manifest hashes and sizes, x86-64 PE headers and private-data exclusions. SHA256 41933c11c7efe8bb751807fc36e12b1ac7792c18db073b86b055695c1a545c72.
Android Docker build passed 24 Kotlin tests; inspected APK integrity, current branding and private-data exclusions. SHA256 2ccd220ea350c2042f8d678c19248b3e6c742df297cf1fd2181d636127301a38.
GitHub release page displayed the three uploaded assets and matching SHA-256 digests, plus SHA256SUMS.txt.
limitations: Android APK is debug-signed preview software; compatibility and uninterrupted audio remain under development. Native Windows, Steam Deck, Android device and live game validation were not performed. A legally obtained supported ROM is required and excluded from packages.
